title: Decursin induces ferroptosis via the NRF2/GPX4/SLC11A2 axis and suppresses migration in hepatocellular carcinoma.
authors: Li, Jingwei; Wang, Zhaoyang; Wei, Kaili; Liu, Qingqing; Liang, Lu; Lin, Jianping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Decursin通过NRF2/GPX4/SLC11A2轴诱导肝癌细胞铁死亡并抑制迁移，虽涉及转录因子NRF2和分子对接，但核心是细胞表型与代谢机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality, and durable therapeutic options remain limited. Ferroptosis has emerged as a therapeutically exploitable vulnerability in HCC. Here, we characterized the anticancer activity of decursin, a natural coumarin derived from Angelica gigas. Decursin reduced the viability and long-term proliferative capacity of HepG2 and Huh7 cells in a dose-dependent manner, with half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC(50)) values of approximately 100 muM and 150 muM, respectively. It also impaired migratory and invasive behaviors while inducing oxidative stress, including lipid peroxidation and glutathione depletion, which are hallmarks of ferroptosis. Integrated transcriptomic and metabolomic profiling revealed a broad disruption of redox and glutathione metabolism, converging on the attenuation of the NRF2-GPX4 antioxidant axis. Computational target prediction and docking further suggested that decursin may influence iron-handling pathways involving SLC11A2, although this relationship requires further validation. In vivo, decursin significantly inhibited tumor growth in xenograft models and reduced NRF2/GPX4 expression. Notably, decursin retained its efficacy in sorafenib-resistant HCC cells. Collectively, these findings identify decursin as a ferroptosis-inducing agent with therapeutic potential in HCC.
abstract_zh: 肝细胞癌（HCC）是癌症相关死亡的主要原因，且持久的治疗选择仍然有限。铁死亡（ferroptosis）已成为HCC中可利用的治疗靶点。在此，我们表征了decursin（一种源自当归（Angelica gigas）的天然香豆素）的抗癌活性。Decursin以剂量依赖性方式降低HepG2和Huh7细胞的活力及长期增殖能力，其半数抑制浓度（IC(50)）值分别约为100 μM和150 μM。它还损害了迁移和侵袭行为，同时诱导氧化应激，包括脂质过氧化和谷胱甘肽耗竭，这些是铁死亡的特征。整合的转录组学和代谢组学分析揭示了氧化还原和谷胱甘肽代谢的广泛紊乱，汇聚于NRF2-GPX4抗氧化轴的减弱。计算靶点预测和对接进一步表明，decursin可能影响涉及SLC11A2的铁处理通路，尽管这一关系需进一步验证。在体内，decursin在异种移植模型中显著抑制肿瘤生长，并降低NRF2/GPX4表达。值得注意的是，decursin在索拉非尼耐药的HCC细胞中仍保持其疗效。综合来看，这些发现将decursin鉴定为一种具有HCC治疗潜力的铁死亡诱导剂。
